suggestions: Output must be a single, valid <svg>...</svg> element
Include xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" on the root <svg> element
Use only static elements: rect, circle, ellipse, line, polyline, polygon, path, text, g, defs, linearGradient, radialGradient, stop
No <script> tags, no event handlers (onclick, onload, etc.), no external references (xlink:href to remote URLs)
Inline styles via the style attribute or a <style> block — no external stylesheets
